components.name: Risk Stamp
components.description: Condensed-caps stamp stating a risk level; the same shape carries VERIFIED, FACT, RULE, and a dashed INFERRED.
components.html: Critical Verified Inferred
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.4rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; font: 700 0.75rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-critical { color: #c8102e; background: #fbe9ec; } .ds-verified { color: #2e7d5b; background: #e6f2ec; } .ds-inferred { color: #4a5b75; background: #fff; border-style: dashed; }

components.name: Numbered Field
components.description: Numbered field row: box number, pre-printed label, filled-in mono value.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 4.875rem minmax(0,1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 5px 16px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6eaef; } .ds-no { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 1.625rem; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid #d3dae3; font: 600 0.7188rem/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #66768e; } .ds-label { padding-top: 4px; font: 600 0.75rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #66768e; } .ds-value { font: 400 0.7812rem/1.45 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #14233f; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Exhibit Tag
components.description: Ink-bordered sheet with the top-right corner notched off by a ground-coloured triangle and a 1px diagonal.
components.css: .ds-tag { --notch: 22px; position: relative; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #14233f; padding: 12px 18px; } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: -1px; border-style: solid; border-width: 0 var(--notch) var(--notch) 0; border-color: transparent #f4f6f8 transparent transparent; } .ds-tag::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; left: calc(100% + 1px - var(--notch)); width: calc(var(--notch) * 1.41421); height: 1px; background: #14233f; transform-origin: 0 0; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-tag-title { font: 800 1.25rem/1.25 'Public Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding-right: 14px; color: #14233f; }

components.name: Custody Log Row
components.description: Signature component: an agent's numbered box, what it did, and the stamp it signed.
components.html:
2
Evidence analyst
Path to direct parent confirmed against tool facts.
Verified
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: start; padding: 10px 16px 12px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6eaef; } .ds-box { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #14233f; font: 600 0.7188rem/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #14233f; } .ds-who { font: 700 0.875rem/1.15 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #14233f; } .ds-what { margin-top: 3px; font: 0.8125rem/1.45 'Public Sans', sans-serif; color: #14233f; } .ds-stamp-v { height: 1.4rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: #2e7d5b; background: #e6f2ec; font: 700 0.75rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Rail Nav Row
components.description: Rail navigation row: mono number, condensed-caps name, count; the current row has an amber left bar.
components.css: .ds-rail { background: #14233f; width: 16.5rem; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-nav { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 22px; border: 0; border-left: 3px solid transparent; background: none; color: #e6ecf4; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav[aria-current='true'] { background: #1d3157; } .ds-nav[aria-current='true'] { border-left-color: #f3c969; } .ds-nav-name { font: 700 1rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-count { font: 0.7812rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #9fb1c9; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3a6fd8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Filter
components.description: Square segmented control; the pressed segment fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #d3dae3; } .ds-seg-btn { height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #d3dae3; background: #fff; font: 700 0.8125rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5b75; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg-btn:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-seg-btn:hover { background: #f4f6f8; color: #14233f; } .ds-seg-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #14233f; color: #e6ecf4; } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3a6fd8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Graph Package Node
components.description: 232x56 package box; a 1.5px risk-coloured border and corner count chip when it carries findings.
components.css: .ds-node { position: relative; width: 232px; height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #c8102e; } .ds-node-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-node-name { font: 600 14.5px/1.15 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #14233f; } .ds-node-ver { font: 400 12.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #66768e; } .ds-node-chip { position: absolute; top: -9px; right: -9px; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; font: 600 11.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #fff; background: #c8102e; border: 1px solid #c8102e; }

narrative.overview:
Guardian is a forensic evidence-intake form rendered as a dashboard. A deep custody-ink rail and header band hold the case and the chain of agents; a cool form-grey ground carries white field sheets divided by one 1px hairline grid. Every finding is an exhibit with a tag, numbered particulars, and a custody log in which each agent signs in sequence. The system refuses the KPI-tile security dashboard and the unlabelled paragraph of AI output.

Density is high and precise: condensed caps for the pre-printed form labels, a plain grotesque for form prose, and monospace for filled-in values, printed whole and never truncated. Corners are square, surfaces are flat, and nothing casts a shadow. Colour is rationed: ink and grey carry structure, and the risk hues appear only where risk is stated.
keyCharacteristics: One 1px hairline grid; separation by line, never by shadow or radius.
Three-voice type: condensed caps label, Public Sans form body, JetBrains Mono value.
Numbered field boxes (1a, 1b) and exhibit numbers act as navigation anchors.
Notched corners (exhibit tag top-right, graph filing tag top-left) as the only silhouette device.
Honest labelling: fact, VERIFIED, INFERRED, rule and rejected each have a distinct stamp.

rules.name: The Risk-Only Rule
rules.body: Red, orange, ochre and slate-low appear only to state a risk level. Structure, selection and emphasis use ink.

rules.name: The Provenance Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber means "an LLM did this". It never signals severity.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every grey is blue-tinted from the ink; no pure grey and no pure black text.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Printed form text is condensed caps, prose is Public Sans, entered data is mono. Never set a value in the form face or a label in mono.

rules.name: The Printed Whole Rule
rules.body: Hashes, ids and paths wrap; they are never ellipsised in the exhibit sheet.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing carries a box-shadow. If a surface needs lifting, give it a hairline or an ink fill.

dos: Do separate regions with a 1px hairline (#d3dae3, or #e6eaef inside rows), not shadow, tint blocks or radius.
Do keep every radius at 0 on surfaces and controls.
Do set labels in Barlow Condensed uppercase with 0.1-0.12em tracking, prose in Public Sans, entered data in JetBrains Mono.
Do pair every risk or claim state with a stamp that carries its word, not colour alone.
Do show a long hash or id in full, wrapped, in the exhibit sheet.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; animation exists only for custody signing, path draw and relay-band growth.
Do use ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` at 120-280ms for state transitions.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, rounded cards, or gradient fills (the only gradients are the notch triangle and the diff hatch).
Don't use risk colours for anything other than a risk level, or amber for anything other than LLM provenance.
Don't introduce a second display face, or set structure in colour where ink works.
Don't put KPI tiles over a table, or present AI output as an unlabelled paragraph; every claim carries fact, VERIFIED, INFERRED or rule.
